@BHAFC’s Pascal Gross was the highest-scoring player in #FPL Gameweek 4 👏

Enzo 💬 (On Ryan McAidoo, Kaden Braithwaite and Floyd Samba) When we started pre-season we had many young players as you know, and then at the end we decided to keep these three players because we think they can improve training with us, and then they can get some minutes. Ryan played in the Premier League twice and Kaden against Palace. The only one who hasn't had minutes is Floyd, but he will.

Enzo 💬 (On rotation of players) For sure, we are going to make some changes. I don't know how many but for different reasons. I’m sure at some stage they will play important games later in the season in the Premier League and Champions League. 

With the amount of games and injuries, players need rest, so for them it is an opportunity to get better, and better, and better, because we will need them in important games.
